notes.title: v 1.1.0
notes.content:
That's the long-awaited update!

Added a new map "Return to NetherEarth", not related to the main storyline. Borrowed from the game of the same name "NetherEarth" in 1987 !!!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32122699/894f86df2fe00d09b601b3764dc78f597970c615.jpg[/img]
Also added 64-bit version of the game and will now be able to control the robots under OS Linux
